Grouped task or user intent: Register school and complete first-time setup
Current FAQ response: Visit our registration page and fill out your school details. Once registered, you can set up your school profile, add your logo and branding, create classes, and invite teachers and staff.
Current chatbot response: To get started, register your institution, complete your school profile, set up your academic structure, and invite staff members as needed.
Observed current flow from app: The app separates setup into multiple places: organization profile and branding, school year and terms, classes and subjects, then student and staff management.
Recommended draft correction: 1. Register the school at /account/register. 2. Log in and open Management. 3. Set school name, logo, theme, and public profile under Personalization. 4. Create school year and terms. 5. Create classes, subjects, and graduation groups. 6. Add staff and then students. 7. Open the other management tools only after the academic structure exists.

Grouped task or user intent: Add logo branding theme and school identity
Current FAQ response: Under the Personalisation settings, you can upload your school logo, set your brand colours and fonts, and customise your public-facing school website.
Current chatbot response: Managira allows schools to personalize parts of their portal by adding items such as a school logo, brand colors, and other organization details.
Current access or pages in app: /account/personalization; website-specific content at /account/managePublicContent; public website theme and layout via /account/updatePublicDashboardTheme and /account/updatePublicDashboardLayout
Observed current flow from app: Branding is split between portal personalization and public website customization. Logo, font, theme, nickname, and organization name are not all in one button.
Recommended draft correction: 1. Open /account/personalization for logo, organization name, nickname, font, and theme. 2. Open /account/managePublicContent for public website sections and images. 3. Use the website theme/layout actions only when you want to change the public site appearance.

Grouped task or user intent: Create school years terms and set the current term
Current FAQ response: Managira supports full academic year management - you can register school years, define terms, close terms to lock in grades, and promote students.
Current chatbot response: Go to the school year or academic records management area, locate the term you want to activate, and set it as the current term.
Observed current flow from app: School year and term management lives in the records/school year workflow. The app supports creating school years, editing terms, deleting terms, closing school years, and viewing term details.
Recommended draft correction: 1. Open Management > School Year. 2. Create or open a school year. 3. Add terms with correct dates. 4. Mark the active term in the school-year management area. 5. Confirm the current term before using attendance, assessments, enrollment, or reports.

Grouped task or user intent: Create classes subjects and graduation year groups
Current FAQ response: Create and manage classes, assign subjects to each class, and define graduation year groups to track student cohorts.
Current chatbot response: Schools can create classes, subjects, and other academic structures needed for teaching, attendance, reporting, and promotion workflows.
Observed current flow from app: The page supports adding classes, adding subjects, assigning existing subjects to classes, editing or deleting classes and subjects, and managing graduation year groups from the same workspace.
Recommended draft correction: 1. Open Management > Class, Subject & Grad Year. 2. Add the class first. 3. Add subjects or assign existing subjects to the class. 4. Create graduation year groups if you track cohorts. 5. Use the same page later for renaming or removing classes and subjects.

Grouped task or user intent: Add edit or correct student information including name dob class guardian and photo
Current FAQ response: Authorised users can update student profiles including personal details, grades, attendance records, and behavioural notes.
Current chatbot response: Open the student's profile and update the fields you need to change, such as personal information, guardian details, contact information, or class assignment.
Observed current flow from app: Student editing is not done from one global settings page. Users normally start in Manage Records or Student Details, then open Edit Student for the selected record.
Recommended draft correction: 1. Open Management > School Year > Manage Records. 2. Search for the student and open Student Details. 3. Use Edit Student. 4. Update grouped fields such as full name, date of birth, class, guardian links, contact details, and image. 5. Save, then reopen Student Details to confirm the change.

Grouped task or user intent: Archive or unarchive a student
Current chatbot response: Students can be archived when they are no longer active in the current class structure but their records still need to be preserved.
Current access or pages in app: /common/archivedStudents and /common/unarchiveStudents; delete route also exists at /common/deleteStudent/:studentId
Observed current flow from app: The app exposes archived student management separately from normal student editing. Deleting and archiving are not the same workflow.
Recommended draft correction: 1. Use archive when you want the student removed from active work lists but kept in history. 2. Open Archived Students to review archived records. 3. Use Unarchive when the student needs to return to active status. 4. Avoid delete unless you intentionally want the destructive path.

Grouped task or user intent: Parent or guardian applies for admission or public registration
Current FAQ response: Schools can enable a public enrollment form on their Managira-powered website. Parents fill out the application online, and school administrators review and approve each submission.
Current chatbot response: If a school has enabled online admission, parents or guardians can complete the application through the school's public page or website.
Current access or pages in app: Public route: /common/publicRegister; related public website pages live under the school's public dashboard
Observed current flow from app: The public admission flow is separate from the internal student management flow. It submits a pending application rather than directly creating a fully approved student record.
Recommended draft correction: 1. Open the school's public admission or registration page. 2. Fill in the student and guardian details. 3. Submit the application. 4. Wait for school review. 5. The student becomes active only after school-side approval.

Grouped task or user intent: Approve reject or edit pending admissions before final approval
Observed current flow from app: The school-side admission review flow already exists but neither the FAQ nor the chatbot explains it clearly.
Recommended draft correction: 1. Open Admissions or Pending Admissions. 2. Review the applicant record and attached image/details. 3. Edit the pending data if needed. 4. Approve to create the student record, or reject to close the application. 5. Use this flow instead of manually re-entering approved applicants.

Grouped task or user intent: Enroll a student into a class or term
Current FAQ response: Schools can create public enrollment forms that parents and guardians fill out online to apply for admission. Applications are reviewed and approved by school administrators. You can also manually add students or bulk-import from spreadsheets.
Current chatbot response: Open the enrollment area and manage registrations or class placement from there.
Observed current flow from app: Enrollment management is its own module. It handles class enrollment records after the student exists in the system.
Recommended draft correction: 1. Open Management > Enrollment. 2. Create or edit the enrollment record. 3. Choose the student, class, and term. 4. Save the enrollment. 5. Return to the enrollment list to verify placement.

Grouped task or user intent: Mark attendance for a class
Current chatbot response: Go to the attendance area for the relevant class and date, then mark each student according to the attendance options available.
Current access or pages in app: Management menu links to /common/attendance; related routes include /common/saveAttendanceForDate, /common/saveSingleAttendance, /common/getAttendanceForClass, /common/attendanceCollection
Observed current flow from app: Attendance depends on the active term, assigned class, and permissions. The save and retrieval actions are separate backend routes.
Recommended draft correction: 1. Open Management > Attendance. 2. Choose the class and date. 3. Mark each student present, absent, late, or the status your school uses. 4. Save the attendance. 5. Reopen the date or class view to confirm it was stored.

Grouped task or user intent: Create a test or assessment
Current FAQ response: Set up tests, record scores, and keep assessments aligned with your grading standards.
Current chatbot response: Open the assessment section for the relevant class or subject, create a new assessment, enter the required details, and save it.
Observed current flow from app: The manage page lists assessment groups and the create page is separate. Users need the current term and organization context.
Recommended draft correction: 1. Open Management > Assessments. 2. Click Create New Test. 3. Enter title, category, max score, weight, and the class-subject assignments. 4. Save the assessment. 5. Return to Manage Assessments to confirm it appears in the list.

Grouped task or user intent: Enter or edit assessment scores
Current FAQ response: Set up tests, record scores, and keep assessments aligned with your grading standards.
Current chatbot response: After creating an assessment, open it and enter the marks or grades for each student.
Observed current flow from app: Score entry is a different step from assessment creation. The app also supports edit windows and score edit restrictions.
Recommended draft correction: 1. Create the assessment first. 2. Open the assessment score-entry page for that test. 3. Enter each student's marks. 4. Save all scores. 5. If scores need later edits, confirm the assessment is still editable or unlock it first.

Grouped task or user intent: Lock unlock or modify an assessment after creation
Observed current flow from app: The assessment manager exposes status, edit windows, lock-unlock control, and modify actions, but the current help content does not explain any of this.
Recommended draft correction: 1. Open Manage Assessments. 2. Find the test in the list. 3. Use Modify to change setup details, or Lock/Unlock to control score editing. 4. Confirm the status badge and editability message after the change.

Grouped task or user intent: Configure grading system and grade boundaries
Current chatbot response: Schools may be able to configure grading structures such as percentages, letter grades, or other assessment models depending on their setup.
Observed current flow from app: Grading configuration is a dedicated page, separate from assessment creation and score entry.
Recommended draft correction: 1. Open Management > Grading System. 2. Define the grading scale your school uses. 3. Add boundaries or pass-fail cutoffs. 4. Save the grading setup before creating or interpreting assessments.

Grouped task or user intent: Generate report cards or merit sheets
Current FAQ response: Managira includes a powerful report generator that creates professional terminal reports and merit sheets automatically from your recorded grades and assessments.
Current chatbot response: Managira supports report generation using recorded academic data such as assessments, grades, attendance information, and comments where applicable.
Current access or pages in app: /common/reports; related student and class pages include /common/studentDetails and /common/classDashboard
Observed current flow from app: Report output depends on the current term and complete academic data. The system also has a dedicated reports hub.
Recommended draft correction: 1. Confirm the current term is correct. 2. Make sure assessments and attendance are complete. 3. Open the Reports hub. 4. Generate the report card or merit sheet for the class or student. 5. Review before printing or sharing.

Grouped task or user intent: Generate or email a transcript
Current chatbot response: Where transcript functionality is enabled, Managira can compile a student's academic history into a transcript-style output for review, printing, or download.
Observed current flow from app: Transcript generation is its own route family and supports signatures and email delivery.
Recommended draft correction: 1. Open the transcript action for the student. 2. Review the generated transcript. 3. Upload or save the required signature if needed. 4. Print, download, or email the transcript from the transcript tools.

Grouped task or user intent: Promote students to the next class or reverse a promotion
Current FAQ response: Promote students to the next year. The system maintains a complete historical record of every academic period.
Current chatbot response: Authorized users can review and apply promotions for students who meet the criteria. If a promotion was applied incorrectly, authorized users may be able to reverse it.
Observed current flow from app: Promotion is a dedicated workflow, not part of class editing. It depends on the school's promotion rules and permissions.
Recommended draft correction: 1. Confirm the current academic period and promotion rules. 2. Open Management > Promotion. 3. Review eligible students and criteria. 4. Apply promotion. 5. If an error was made, use the reversal workflow before more dependent work is done.

Grouped task or user intent: Create edit or remove employee accounts
Current FAQ response: Add, update, and manage employee profiles including teachers, administrators, and support staff.
Current chatbot response: Authorized users can create a new employee account by entering the staff member's details, assigning a role, and linking responsibilities.
Current access or pages in app: /common/management -> Employee -> /common/manageEmployees; create at /common/createEmployee; edit at /common/modifyEmployee; delete at /common/deleteEmployee/:userId
Observed current flow from app: Employee management is centralized. Role assignment and account creation are part of the same workflow family.
Recommended draft correction: 1. Open Management > Employee. 2. Use Create Employee for new staff. 3. Assign the role and required details. 4. Use Modify Employee for updates. 5. Use delete or hold actions carefully for access changes.

Grouped task or user intent: Review staff access and assign roles or extra permissions
Current chatbot response: Authorized users can review staff records and assigned permissions from the employee or staff management area.
Current access or pages in app: Main entry is /common/manageEmployees; permission-protected routes and role behavior are enforced across the app
Observed current flow from app: The help text currently explains role concepts but not where managers actually go to review access.
Recommended draft correction: 1. Open Manage Employees. 2. Open the relevant staff member. 3. Review role, class assignments, and permissions. 4. Update only the access needed for that staff member's job. 5. Re-test the feature from that account after saving.

Grouped task or user intent: Create edit or link guardian accounts to students
Current FAQ response: Create and manage guardian or parent accounts, link them to students, and control their portal access.
Current chatbot response: Depending on the school's workflow, authorized staff may be able to create or link guardian records for families who need help getting started.
Observed current flow from app: Guardian management is a school-side workspace separate from the guardian's own portal. Linking and unlinking students is handled there.
Recommended draft correction: 1. Open Management > Parents/Guardian. 2. Search or open the guardian record. 3. Edit guardian details if needed. 4. Link or remove student relationships carefully. 5. Use the password reset action when portal access needs to be restored.

Grouped task or user intent: Guardian logs in and views child information
Current FAQ response: Parents and guardians can access their child's school information through the dedicated Guardian Portal.
Current chatbot response: Once they have valid login details and are linked to the relevant student records, they can sign in and view the information made available to them.
Observed current flow from app: Guardian access is a separate portal, not the staff login. The account must already be linked to the student.
Recommended draft correction: 1. Go to /account/guardian-login. 2. Sign in with the guardian account provided by the school. 3. Open Dashboard, Student, or Academic Details to view the child record. 4. If the child is missing, the school should review the guardian-student link.

Grouped task or user intent: Guardian submits a report concern or question to the school
Current FAQ response: The Guardian Portal includes a reporting feature where parents can submit concerns, questions, or feedback directly to the school.
Current chatbot response: Where enabled, the Guardian Portal can allow parents or guardians to submit concerns, reports, questions, or feedback directly to the school.
Observed current flow from app: The current content mentions the feature but does not show the real report list and new-report flow.
Recommended draft correction: 1. Log in to the Guardian Portal. 2. Open Reports. 3. Click New Report. 4. Enter the concern and submit it. 5. Return to the same report later to read replies or add more information.

Grouped task or user intent: Create or manage announcements and events
Current FAQ response: Announcements are published to dashboards across the platform and can also display on the public-facing website.
Current chatbot response: Announcements can be displayed through school or user dashboards and may also appear on the public-facing school page or website.
Observed current flow from app: Announcements and events are managed from one combined workspace. The routes support create, update, and delete operations.
Recommended draft correction: 1. Open Management > Announcements & Events. 2. Choose whether you are creating an announcement or an event. 3. Enter the content, audience, and timing details. 4. Save. 5. Return to the management list to edit or delete later.

Grouped task or user intent: Update the public school website and its sections
Current FAQ response: Manage your school's public website content including galleries, articles, events, and announcements.
Current chatbot response: Authorized users may be able to create, update, publish, and arrange website sections such as banners, galleries, or content blocks.
Observed current flow from app: Public website content is handled in the account website management area, not in the general FAQ or management menu alone.
Recommended draft correction: 1. Open Website Settings or /account/managePublicContent. 2. Update the sections you need, such as slides, text blocks, about-us content, or images. 3. Save each change. 4. Use the theme and layout actions only for appearance changes.

Grouped task or user intent: Create use and share Docs or Sheets
Current chatbot response: Managira may include support for files such as rich-text documents and spreadsheets depending on the enabled features for your institution.
Observed current flow from app: The file feature is real and permission-based, but the help content is still too generic about how staff actually start using it.
Recommended draft correction: 1. Open Docs or Sheets from Management. 2. Create a new document or sheet. 3. Edit the content. 4. Use the permissions action to assign access to classes or staff. 5. Reopen the file list to verify it saved.

Grouped task or user intent: Set up PayGira for school billing and collections
Current FAQ response: A school first configures its payment settings and payout destination, then creates bills, chooses who each bill applies to, enables accepted payment methods, and optionally assigns staff collectors or overseers.
Observed current flow from app: PayGira finance setup is much more concrete than the generic billing FAQ. The finance workspace supports PSP setup, templates, bills, payments, arrears, reminders, and exports.
Recommended draft correction: 1. Open the Finance workspace. 2. Configure payment settings and payout destination. 3. Create bill templates if needed. 4. Create bills and assign the applicable students or groups. 5. Enable payment methods and collectors. 6. Review balances from the finance dashboard.

Grouped task or user intent: Staff collects payments in My PayGira and signs off completed collections
Current FAQ response: Assigned teachers, class teachers, supervisors, managers, and finance administrators can use My PayGira to record collections. A bill or recurring date can only be signed off after it is fully settled.
Observed current flow from app: My PayGira is a separate staff collection workspace with collection and sign-off actions already implemented.
Recommended draft correction: 1. Open My PayGira. 2. Find the bill or recurring date under your responsibility. 3. Record one payment or use bulk collection. 4. Confirm balances update. 5. When the bill scope is fully settled, use Sign Off and confirm with password.

Grouped task or user intent: Guardian views bills and pays through PayGira
Current FAQ response: In the Guardian Portal, parents can open PayGira, review each child's billed, paid, outstanding, and available credit amounts, and then pay the selected bill or recurring dates.
Observed current flow from app: Parent-facing PayGira already supports payment, invoice, receipt, and saved-card workflows.
Recommended draft correction: 1. Log in to the Guardian Portal. 2. Open PayGira. 3. Review the child's outstanding bills. 4. Choose a bill and payment method. 5. Complete the payment. 6. Reopen PayGira or the receipt page to confirm success.

Grouped task or user intent: Upgrade downgrade or cancel a subscription
Current FAQ response: You can change your plan at any time from the Settings or Billing section of your account. Upgrades take effect immediately.
Current chatbot response: Schools can typically change plans from the billing or subscription area of their account, subject to the rules of the active billing cycle.
Observed current flow from app: Plan changes and cancellation are account-side billing actions, not part of the finance workspace used for school fee collection.
Recommended draft correction: 1. Open the service plan page to review available plans. 2. Choose the new plan if upgrading or downgrading. 3. Use cancel subscription only if you intend to stop renewal. 4. Review the billing-cycle effect before confirming.

Grouped task or user intent: Forgot password or reset account access
Current chatbot response: Use the Forgot Password option on the login page and enter the email address linked to your account. You should receive a reset link.
Current access or pages in app: /account/forget-password and /account/reset-password; guardians also have school-side reset support via /common/guardianRequestPasswordReset
Observed current flow from app: Password reset is route-based and separate from login. Guardian resets may also be triggered internally by school staff.
Recommended draft correction: 1. Open the login page and choose Forgot Password. 2. Enter the email tied to the account. 3. Open the reset link from email. 4. Set the new password on the reset page. 5. If no email arrives, verify the account email and ask the school to review the account.

Grouped task or user intent: Invite schools into a hub or manage hub membership
Current FAQ response: Hub operators can send invitations to existing Managira schools as well as new institutions.
Current chatbot response: Hub operators can invite schools already using Managira, as well as new schools, depending on permissions.
Observed current flow from app: The product has a distinct hub area for multi-school oversight, but the help content still stays high-level and does not explain the actual operator flow.
Recommended draft correction: 1. Sign in to the Hub dashboard. 2. Open the organization or invitation area. 3. Send an invitation to the target school. 4. Track acceptance and confirm how billing and oversight should behave after the school joins.

Grouped task or user intent: Use analytics dashboard reports and activity logs
Current FAQ response: Managira's analytics dashboard provides visual insights into student performance trends, attendance statistics, class comparisons, and operational metrics.
Observed current flow from app: The current content mentions analytics but not the actual pages. There is an organization dashboard plus a reports hub and activity logs page.
Recommended draft correction: 1. Open the organization dashboard for high-level metrics. 2. Open Reports for report-focused workflows. 3. Use Activity Logs when you need a detailed history of actions or changes.
